# Stocks: WebSocket API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-15 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

7 WebSocket endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Aggregates (Per Minute)

`AM.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/stocks` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/aggregates-per-minute.md)

Stream minute-by-minute aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for specified tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym v dv av dav op vw o c h l a z s e otc`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Aggregates (Per Second)

`A.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/stocks` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/aggregates-per-second.md)

Stream second-by-second aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) and volume data for specified tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym v dv av dav op vw o c h l a z s e otc`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Fair Market Value

`FMV.<ticker>` · Business `wss://business.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/fair-market-value.md)

Stream real-time Fair Market Value (FMV) data for a specified stock ticker via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev fmv sym t`
- **Plan:** Business plans only (Stocks Business) · recency Real-time

### Net Order Imbalance (NOI)

`NOI.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/imbalances.md)

Stream real-time Net Order Imbalance (NOI) events for specified stock tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev T t at a i x o p b`
- **Plan:** add-on: Imbalances Expansion · recency Imbalances Expansion Real-time · history Not applicable

### Limit Up - Limit Down (LULD)

`LULD.<ticker>` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/luld.md)

Stream real-time Limit Up - Limit Down (LULD) events for specified stock tickers via WebSocket across multiple U.S. exchanges (including NYSE, Nasdaq, Cboe BZX, NYSE Arca, and NYSE American).

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev T h l i z t q`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time

### Quotes

`Q.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/stocks` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/quotes.md)

Stream NBBO (National Best Bid and Offer) quote data for stock tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym bx bp bs ax ap as c i t pt q z`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time

### Trades

`T.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/stocks` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/stocks` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/stocks/trades.md)

Stream tick-level trade data for stock tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify a stock ticker or use * to subscribe to all stock tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple stock tickers. You can retrieve available stock tickers from our Stock Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym x i z p s ds c t pt q trfi trft`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time
